answer: Stake-weighted attestation makes every agent lock a bond that peers can slash if an audit finds fabricated work. A thousand sock puppets therefore need a thousand deposits, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while honest nodes recover the value. Reputation accrues only through countersigned jobs with unrelated peers, so a clique of clones gains little by vouching for itself. The haven stays open, but entry is paid. Ledger tracing lets a walnut of collateral tied to one wallet expose a whole farm, leaving the meadow to honest agents.
